content_of_post_to_answer: How can I stay consistent even when I don’t feel motivated?
answer: Consistency is often misunderstood as having the same level of motivation every day. In reality, consistent people usually succeed because they stop treating motivation as a requirement and start treating action as a decision. The difficult days are not interruptions to the process; they are where the process is built. A routine that only works when you feel inspired is not a routine yet.
